name: caveman-agent-sdk-repository
description: Open-source monorepo for Caveman Agent SDK, adapters, protocol, coding agent, and initializer.

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:evals && npm run build:agent && npm run build:create-agent
scripts.test: npm run license:check && npm run check:catalog && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:evals && npm run test:adapter-kit && npm run test:adapter-conformance && npm run test:coding-agent && npm run test:package-types && npm run test:agent && npm run test:adapters && npm run test:conformance-candidates && npm run test:create-agent && npm run test:example
scripts.test:adapters: for d in packages/adapters/*/; do npm --prefix "$d" test --if-present || exit 1; done
